$comment: Pi-side settings for the mcp-combiner extension's client half. Copy to $PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/extensions/mcp-combiner.json (default ~/.config/pi/agent/extensions/). Connection URL and per-project server exposure live in the shared MCP config ladder (.pi/mcp.json / ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json) instead — see README. Env vars (PI_MCP_COMBINER_*) win over this file. adapter: true = we are the MCP tool; false = legacy mode (pi-mcp-adapter owns MCP, this extension only launches the process + injects instructions); "auto" (default) = false when pi-mcp-adapter is detected installed, true otherwise.
